The strip takes the page too; on the light side its white logo is inverted as the header’s is (sideRules.light); 20/10/2026 (1.0.3): the Home 3 text slider paints its strip with T4’s --color-dark, which the slot points at the system text colour: a cream strip with the headings’ own cream on it under Moxie (1.82:1), black under Figma; it takes the warm surface, the step lighter than the page it is in the template’s look; 20/10/2026 (1.0.4): the pagination's hover, focus and pressed states take the accent fill and its words, as the template fills them with its gold: the slot's framework rule (.page-link on the surface) outweighed the template's state rule, so under a system a page link looked the same under the pointer as at rest (HOVER-2 hover-same, the typography page's Previous / Next under Moxie)
keepNote: the testimonial band (#t4-section-8, the layout section that holds it; its .bg-dark wrapper is painted with --color-dark, which the family points at the system text) keeps its dark ground, white quote and gold author: worn, its ground turned light under a dark system and the quote read 1.3–1.8:1
bandsNote: drafted 2026-10-12 by scripts/bands.mjs off the released default page (/): each kept band that is not a picture wears the system's ground (src/bands.mjs), its words keep their colours; on /about two blocks of features (.acm-features.style-4, the text beside the restaurant photo, and .acm-features.style-5, the six feature cards) sit straight on the template’s dark page with its white words and white line icons: in the kept .acm-features band (no ground of its own) they were white on white under every light system (Stripe, visual review 14/10/2026). sideRulesNote: the page-title masthead (.ja-masthead.has-bg) fades its photo into the page with a ::before gradient to the page colour, under white words made for the dark page: under a light system it faded to white under the white title (Stripe, visual review 14/10/2026).
